source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of kidney stones and their treatment (PDF 19-20).

blocks.text: Peshab ki (gurde ki) pathriyan sakht, qalmi (crystalline) maadni zarraat hain jo jur kar gurde ya peshab ki nali mein chhote kankar ban jate hain. Yeh gurdon mein reh sakti hain ya peshab ki nali se bahar nikal sakti hain.

blocks.caption: Gurde ki pathri ki qismein
rows: hypercalciuria (peshab mein zyada calcium) aur hyperoxaluria (peshab mein zyada oxalate)

blocks.text: Musalsal pani ki kami pathri banne ka imkan barhati hai. Doctor peshab ke test se pathri ki qism ka andaza laga sakte hain: tezabi peshab calcium oxalate, alkaline peshab calcium phosphate aur musalsal tezabi peshab uric acid ki taraf ishara karta hai.

items: Extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy (ECSWL): lithotripter naam ka aala mareez ke jism ke bahar se shockwaves banata hai; yeh pathri ko chhote tukron mein torti hain, jin mein se zyada tar peshab ke saath nikal jate hain.

Percutaneous nephrolithotripsy (PNL), bari pathriyon ke liye: mareez ki kamar se gurde mein tube dali jati hai, us mein se chhota camera (nephroscope) pathri dekhne ke liye guzara jata hai, ultrasound ka aala pathri torta hai, aur tukre pakar kar bahar kheench liye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar panel. Gurde ki pathri torna: jism ke bahar lithotripter pathri par shockwaves bhejta hai (ECSWL), aur bari pathri ke liye kamar se tube daal kar nephroscope aur ultrasound se tori aur nikali jati hai (PNL). Pathri ki qismon ka table, wajah aur peshab ke test ke saath. Haemodialysis: artery ka khoon cellulose membrane wale dialyzer se pump hota, dialysate ulti simt behta, saaf khoon vein mein wapas. Peritoneal dialysis: dialysate pait mein dala, chhora, phir nikala jata hai.
blocks.caption: Gurde ki pathri torna: ECSWL aur PNL, aur pathri ki qismein (Figures 14.5 aur 14.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Taqreeban 70% pathriyan calcium oxalate ki hoti hain (peshab mein zyada calcium aur oxalate se; peshab tezabi), taqreeban 10% uric acid ki (khoon mein zyada uric acid se; peshab musalsal tezabi), aur baqi calcium phosphate (alkaline peshab) ya cystine aur phosphates ki; musalsal pani ki kami khatra barhati hai. Pathri lithotripsy se tori jati hai: jism ke bahar se shockwaves (ECSWL) ya bari pathri ke liye kamar ki tube se nephroscope aur ultrasound (PNL). Haemodialysis mein khoon semipermeable cellulose membrane ke paas se guzarta jis ki doosri taraf dialysate hai, to fuzlaat, zaid pani aur namak us mein chale jate hain; dono ulti simton mein behte hain ta ke poore raaste farq (gradient) qaim rahe. Peritoneal dialysis mein 1.5 se 2 L dialysate 4 se 6 ghante pait mein reh kar peritoneum ke zariye fuzlaat jama karta aur din mein kai baar nikala jata hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab pathri ki wajahon mein 'cysteine' chhapti hai. Pathri banane wala madda cystine hai, jo do cysteine milne se banne wala dohra molecule hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik mareez ka peshab har test mein tezabi rehta hai. Kaunsi pathri ka imkan zyada hai, aur aam taur par pathri ka khatra kya barhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Uric acid ki pathri, jo khoon mein zyada uric acid (hyperuricemia) se judi hai. Musalsal pani ki kami har pathri ka khatra barhati hai.

items: Pathriyan: calcium oxalate 70%, uric acid 10%, cystine aur phosphates; pani ki kami khatra barhati hai.
Lithotripsy: ECSWL (bahar se shockwaves) ya PNL (kamar mein tube, nephroscope, ultrasound).
